siteMeta.name: Ironhaus Strength Co.
siteMeta.tagline: Train hard. Move well. Stay dangerous.

hero.subtitle: A no-mirror-selfie strength gym for people who want to get genuinely strong, move without pain, and look like they lift. Coaches, not influencers.
hero.backgroundAlt: A loaded olympic barbell resting on the concrete floor of a dim industrial gym with chalk dust in the air

about.title: Not a fitness club. A training hall.
about.lead: We built Ironhaus for the people the big-box gyms forgot: adults who want real coaching, real barbells, and real accountability.
paragraphs: Every member starts with an assessment, not a sales pitch. We figure out how you move, what hurts, and what you actually want — then we write a plan and stand next to you while you run it.
Our floor is 8,000 square feet of platforms, rigs, and open turf. No mandatory playlists, no photo-op lighting. Just good equipment, loud music, and coaches who know your name and your numbers.
about.pullQuote: The goal was never to be the biggest gym in town. It was to be the one you never outgrow.
about.imageAlt: A large steel pull-up and squat rig inside a spacious industrial gym
about.secondaryImageAlt: A chalk-covered barbell with a cloud of chalk dust

programs.title: Pick your path — or run them all.
programs.intro: Every program is coached in small groups and progressed on a real periodized plan. Switch anytime; your membership covers all of them.

items.name: Barbell Strength
items.forWho: Lifters who want a bigger total
items.description: Linear and block periodization built around the big three, with accessory work that keeps your joints happy while your numbers climb.

items.name: Engine Room
items.description: Bikes, rowers, sleds, and carries programmed by heart-rate zones so you build a gas tank without wrecking your recovery.

items.name: Build
items.description: Bodybuilding-style volume with intelligent progression, tempo work, and enough variety to keep every muscle group honest.

items.name: Foundations
items.description: Learn the lifts from scratch in a small, judgment-free group before you step onto the main floor. No experience required.

items.name: Restore
items.description: Guided mobility, breathing, and tissue work that undoes what sitting all day does to your hips, shoulders, and spine.

items.name: Team Barbell
items.description: Our competition track for members prepping for meets and throwdowns — programmed peaks, mock meets, and a whole lot of yelling.

items.q: I've never touched a barbell. Am I going to embarrass myself?
items.a: No. Everyone starts in Foundations, a small beginner group where you learn the lifts from scratch. Most members are 'former beginners' — you'll fit right in.

items.q: Do I need to be in shape before I join?
items.a: That's like cleaning before the cleaner arrives. Come as you are; getting in shape is literally the point, and every workout scales to your level.
Never. Every membership is month-to-month and you can cancel anytime from the app. We'd rather keep you because you love it than because you're trapped.

items.q: Can I freeze my membership if I travel?
items.a: Yes — you can freeze for up to three months a year at no charge. Just flip the switch in your member portal.

items.q: What should I bring to my first session?
items.a: Training clothes, flat shoes or lifters, a water bottle, and a slightly open mind. We provide chalk, equipment, and more encouragement than you'll expect.
Member and Private tiers include nutrition coaching with a real plan and check-ins. No fad diets, no shakes to sell you — just sustainable habits.
